query:
SELECT r.name
        FROM resources r
        JOIN users u ON u.id = $1 AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE r.id = ANY($2)
          AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND r.reservation_restricted = TRUE
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM resource_groups rg
              WHERE rg.resource_id = r.id AND rg.group_id = u.group_id
          )
        ORDER BY r.name
        LIMIT 1
